effect.name: Corner Pin
effect.description: Distort the clip by shifting its four corners. Use it to stretch, shrink, skew or simulate perspective, for example to fit a screen replacement into a moving shot
effect.author: libavfilter

parameter.name: av.x0
Upper Left X
parameter.comment: X position (in pixels) of the clip's upper left corner

parameter.name: av.y0
Upper Left Y
parameter.comment: Y position (in pixels) of the clip's upper left corner

parameter.name: av.x1
Upper Right X
parameter.comment: X position (in pixels) of the clip's upper right corner

parameter.name: av.y1
Upper Right Y
parameter.comment: Y position (in pixels) of the clip's upper right corner

parameter.name: av.x2
Lower Left X
parameter.comment: X position (in pixels) of the clip's lower left corner

parameter.name: av.y2
Lower Left Y
parameter.comment: Y position (in pixels) of the clip's lower left corner

parameter.name: av.x3
Lower Right X
parameter.comment: X position (in pixels) of the clip's lower right corner

parameter.name: av.y3
Lower Right Y
parameter.comment: Y position (in pixels) of the clip's lower right corner

parameter.name: av.interpolation
Interpolation
parameter.comment: Interpolation method used to remap the pixels

parameter.name: av.sense
Sense
parameter.comment:
Destination (default) moves the clip's corners to the positions entered above.
Source instead grabs the quad described by the positions from the clip and stretches it to fill the whole frame.
